chunks: The wretched one is he who is wretched in his mother's womb.

key_terms.اَلشَّقِيُّ: the wretched one; the person marked by misery or ill-fate
key_terms.بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ: his mother's womb; the prenatal state

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says the wretched one is wretched in his mother's womb?
ai.summary: This hadith expresses a concise teaching about ultimate wretchedness being tied to one's state from the earliest stage of existence. It is thematically connected to questions of divine decree, human destiny, and the reality of felicity or wretchedness.
